note: The only spellings whose analysis differs from the baseline fingerprint. Each is a documented correction made during the coverage expansion; nothing else changed.

فَقَدَرَ.reason: Baseline read the noun qadar; the spelling with the object-less verb in 89:16 is the verb (fa + qadara).

أَسْمَعَهُمْ.reason: Baseline read the imperfect of samia with a pronoun; the spelling is the fourth-form verb asma'a + pronoun (8:23).

أَذَاقَهُم.reason: Baseline read the interrogative a- + dhaqa; the spelling is the fourth-form verb adhaqa + pronoun.

وَأَشْهَدَهُمْ.reason: Baseline read wa + a- + shahida (1st person, interrogative a-); the form with an object pronoun is the fourth-form verb ashhada (7:172).

أَدْرِى.reason: Baseline used the lemma adraa; the spelling is the 1st person imperfect of daraa (I know).

لَّأَسْمَعَهُمْ.reason: Same as the previous asma'a spelling, with the emphatic lam (8:23).

أَذْهَبَ.reason: Baseline read the 1st person imperfect of dhahaba; the Qur'anic use (35:34) is the fourth-form perfect adhhaba.
